description: Final executable CVAE-A artifacts for provincial hourly demand scenario generation.

preprocessing.c_order: calendar_binary followed by scaled(calendar_ordinal + climate + socioeconomic). For CVAE-A socioeconomic is empty.
preprocessing.c_scaler: StandardScaler fitted only on calendar ordinal and climate columns from training conditions.
preprocessing.x_scaler: StandardScaler fitted only on training demand profiles.
